description: This file contains unit tests for the ElasticSearchEngine class within the SuiteCRM project. It tests methods such as validation of queries, creation of search parameters, execution of search, and parsing of results, utilizing mock objects and test data.

classes.name: ElasticSearchEngineTest
classes.description: A unit test class for ElasticSearchEngine, ensuring its methods behave correctly under various conditions.

methods.name: testValidateQuery
methods.description: Tests the validation and normalization of search queries.

methods.name: testCreateSearchParams1
methods.description: Verifies creation of search parameters with specific query string, size, and offset.

methods.name: testCreateSearchParams2
methods.description: Verifies creation of search parameters with only query string and size.

methods.name: testRunElasticSearch
methods.description: Tests execution of the ElasticSearch query and retrieval of mocked search results.

methods.name: testParseEmptyHits
methods.description: Ensures parsing function correctly handles empty search results.
